facts.claim: Greek hotels charge the climate crisis resilience fee per room per night under Law 5177/2025 article 44: from April to October €2 (1-2 stars), €5 (3 stars), €10 (4 stars), €15 (5 stars); from November to March €0.50, €1.50, €3 and €4.

sources.title: Government Gazette A' 21/14.02.2025: Law 5177/2025, article 44 (copy hosted by nomotelia.gr)
AADE: FAQ for the Climate Resilience Fee Declaration, January 2026

articles/where-to-stay-in-athens.html: are set in article 44 of Law 5177/2025
The fee is charged per room per night, and the amount depends on the hotel's stars and on the month
four nights in a four-star hotel in July cost 4 × €10 = €40

facts.claim: The hotel collects the fee from the guest after the stay and before departure with a special receipt; for stays across months one receipt is issued per month; the receipt carries no VAT and the fee is not charged for free stays.

sources.title: Government Gazette A' 21/14.02.2025: Law 5177/2025, article 44 (copy hosted by nomotelia.gr)
